what: The volatile-only allowlist includes canonical token-report.json and timing-report.json, so a refresh whose only substantive change is new token/timing data can be skipped.
scenario_or_breakage: After a CI fixer or rebase, the only changed run-log files may be token-report.json/timing-report.json; the plan would treat them as volatile-only and leave merged logs stale.
suggested_fix: Narrow the skip to refresh-only sidecars, or compare normalized report content and skip only when volatile fields changed.
